_comment: Judge and type-classifier identities, and the family-disjointness record.
STATUS MUST BE 'confirmed' BEFORE ANY REPORTED RUN. Owner sets the ids.
Rationale is recorded on standalone merits: open weights with per-token
logit access (required for the single-token readout), mid-scale so a
130-step trajectory fits the prefix budget on available hardware, and cheap
enough to run every ablation arm over both subsets.
The type-classifier must be family-disjoint from BOTH judge families:
typing conditions the judge's evidence policy, so any shared family closes
